name: de.donostiasansebastian/gozatu
title: Gozatu! Donostia-San Sebastián
description: San Sebastián food & travel guide: bars, opening hours, buses, events – with interactive map view

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Gozatu! guide (German) to Donostia-San Sebastián and the Basque Country: pintxos bars, restaurants, recipes, sights, day trips, festivals, practical travel tips. Returns matching articles with id, title and url. Use fetch with the id to read an article. Queries work best in German or with local names (e.g. "Gilda", "Txakoli", "Parte Vieja").

query.description: Search terms, e.g. "beste Pintxos Parte Vieja" or "Flughafen Bilbao Bus".

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Return the full text (German) of one Gozatu! article or page. Pass the id from search, or any article URL on donostiasansebastian.de. The result contains title, text, url and metadata (published, updated, description).

id.description: The id returned by search (the article URL), a URL on donostiasansebastian.de, or a numeric post id.

tools.name: find_places
tools.description: Find pintxos bars, restaurants, cafes and wineries that Gozatu! has visited and reviewed in Donostia-San Sebastián and the Basque Country. Filter by name or keyword, district, type, opening time ("now" or a date and time) and distance to a point. Each place has its review URL, type, district, coordinates, opening hours for the requested day and whether it is open at that time; restaurant holidays are taken into account. Opening hours come from the author's reviews, not from the venues in real time.

district.description: Optional district of San Sebastián, e.g. "Parte Vieja", "Gros", "Centro", "Antiguo", "Egia", "Amara".

type.description: Optional type: bar (pintxos bar), restaurant, cafe, weingut (winery), other (sights and others).

open_at.description: Optional: "now" or a local date and time such as "2026-12-19T20:30" (Europe/Madrid). Only places open at that time are returned.

near_lat.description: Optional latitude of a point; results are sorted by distance.

radius_m.description: Optional radius in metres around the point (default 1000, maximum 50000).

tools.name: next_departures
tools.description: Next scheduled direct bus and train departures between Donostia-San Sebastián and a destination: flughafen (Bilbao Airport), hendaye (El Topo train to France), getaria, zarautz, zumaia, orio, deba, hondarribia, pasaia, astigarraga, hernani, tolosa, bilbao, vitoria. Source: open timetable data of the Basque Government (Moveuskadi). Scheduled times, not real-time; times are local (Europe/Madrid).

destination.description: Destination key or name, e.g. "flughafen", "Bilbao Airport", "hendaye", "getaria".

direction.description: from_donostia (default): San Sebastián to the destination; to_donostia: back to San Sebastián.

at.description: Optional local date and time, e.g. "2026-12-19T08:00"; default is now.

tools.name: trip_check
tools.description: For a travel period in Donostia-San Sebastián: festivals and events, holidays of top restaurants, which reviewed places are closed on which weekday, cider house (Txotx) season and seasonal products. Field names and texts are German (feste = festivals, betriebsferien = restaurant holidays, ruhetage = closing days, saison = seasonal products).

tools.name: ask_gozatu
tools.description: Short, sourced answers (German) from more than 2,600 questions and answers in Gozatu! articles about San Sebastián and the Basque Country: food and drink, customs, prices, transport, beaches, festivals, individual bars and restaurants. Ask in German for best results. Each answer comes with the article it is taken from.

question.description: The question, e.g. "Was ist eine Gilda?" or "Wie viel Trinkgeld gibt man in San Sebastián?".
